headline.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS: the next generation of expressive AI speech
headline.summary: Gemini has launched its 3.1 Flash TTS, a new version of its text-to-speech technology designed to enhance expressiveness in AI-generated speech. This update aims to improve the naturalness and emotional range of synthesized voices for various applications.

articles.title: DeepL, known for text translation, now wants to translate your voice
articles.summary: DeepL has announced its plans to expand beyond text translation by developing technology for real-time voice translation, aiming to integrate with meeting platforms such as Zoom and Microsoft Teams. The new feature is expected to enhance communication in multilingual settings.

articles.title: AI-Assisted Peer Review at Scale: The AAAI-26 AI Review Pilot
articles.summary: The AAAI-26 conference has launched a pilot program for AI-assisted peer review to address challenges in maintaining review quality amid increasing submission volumes. This initiative marks the first large-scale implementation of AI in the peer review process, aiming to evaluate its effectiveness in generating technically sound reviews.

articles.title: 4th Workshop on Maritime Computer Vision (MaCVi): Challenge Overview
articles.summary: The 4th Workshop on Maritime Computer Vision (MaCVi) will take place during CVPR 2026, featuring five benchmark challenges focused on predictive accuracy and real-time feasibility. The report details the challenge setup, evaluation protocols, datasets, and presents various analyses of emerging methods and trends in maritime computer vision.

articles.title: L2D-Clinical: Learning to Defer for Adaptive Model Selection in Clinical Text Classification
articles.summary: The L2D-Clinical framework introduces a method for adaptive model selection in clinical text classification by determining when a BERT classifier should defer to a general-purpose large language model based on uncertainty signals and text characteristics. This approach addresses the limitations of existing models, which do not consistently outperform one another across all instances.

articles.title: A 3D SAM-Based Progressive Prompting Framework for Multi-Task Segmentation of Radiotherapy-induced Normal Tissue Injuries in Limited-Data Settings
articles.summary: A new framework utilizing 3D SAM-based progressive prompting has been developed for the multi-task segmentation of radiotherapy-induced normal tissue injuries in scenarios with limited data. This approach aims to improve the accuracy of injury region segmentation from medical images, which is crucial for disease assessment and treatment planning.

articles.title: DF3DV-1K: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Distractor-Free Novel View Synthesis
articles.summary: The DF3DV-1K dataset has been introduced to support the development of distractor-free novel view synthesis by providing a large-scale collection of clean and cluttered images for comprehensive benchmarking. This dataset aims to facilitate advancements in photorealistic radiance fields, addressing the current lack of resources in this area.

articles.title: Monthly Diffusion v0.9: A Latent Diffusion Model for the First AI-MIP
articles.summary: Monthly Diffusion v0.9 is a climate emulator that utilizes a Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder architecture to model low-frequency internal atmospheric variability through latent diffusion at a 1.5-degree grid spacing. This version is optimized for monthly mean timesteps and operates effectively in data-sparse conditions with modest computational requirements.

articles.title: Beyond Voxel 3D Editing: Learning from 3D Masks and Self-Constructed Data
articles.summary: The article discusses advancements in 3D editing techniques that focus on maintaining semantic consistency and local invariance during modifications. It highlights the limitations of current methods, such as multi-view editing and voxel-based approaches, and proposes learning from 3D masks and self-constructed data to improve editing outcomes.

articles.title: FRAGATA: Semantic Retrieval of HPC Support Tickets via Hybrid RAG over 20 Years of Request Tracker History
articles.summary: The paper introduces FRAGATA, a hybrid retrieval system designed to enhance the semantic search capabilities of a supercomputing center's historical support ticket database, which spans over 20 years. By addressing the limitations of the existing Request Tracker search engine, FRAGATA aims to improve knowledge reuse among the technical support team at the Galician Supercomputing Center (CESGA).

articles.title: A Dynamic-Growing Fuzzy-Neuro Controller, Application to a 3PSP Parallel Robot
articles.summary: A Dynamic Growing Fuzzy Neural Controller (DGFNC) is proposed for position control of a 3PSP parallel robot, integrating fuzzy systems with neural networks for enhanced decision-making. The study emphasizes the dynamic growing mechanism within the controller, showcasing its application in robotic systems.

articles.title: Gaslight, Gatekeep, V1-V3: Early Visual Cortex Alignment Shields Vision-Language Models from Sycophantic Manipulation
articles.summary: A recent study investigates the alignment of early visual cortex representations in vision-language models to determine their vulnerability to sycophantic manipulation. The research explores whether models that better reflect human neural processing are more resilient to adversarial influences, highlighting important implications for both neuroscience and AI safety.
